Who it is for

Every Punjab exam, where state-specific questions are the section most candidates under-prepare.

Buy it if

Nothing to buy - this is the free material on this site.

Avoid it if

Nobody. Start with the category you are weakest in.

How to use it

One category at a time: read the notes, attempt the set, then return to that category after two days.
